summary: Continues SSH project sync through a proxy: set control_plane_execution_environment: localhost/my-env in group_vars/automationcontroller, run setup.sh, create an ssh_config with a ProxyCommand using nc, and expose /var/lib/awx/.ssh:/etc/ssh:O in Paths to expose to isolated jobs.
questions: How do I set control_plane_execution_environment for project sync?
Where do I put ssh_config with ProxyCommand for controller project sync?
How do I expose ssh_config to isolated jobs?

answer_card.title: SSH project sync through a proxy
answer_card.answer_md:
1. `group_vars/automationcontroller`: `control_plane_execution_environment: localhost/my-env`, then `./setup.sh`.
2. `/var/lib/awx/.ssh/ssh_config` (owned by awx):
```
Host github.com
Hostname ssh.github.com
ProxyCommand nc --proxy-type http --proxy proxy.example.com:port %h %p
User git
```
3. **Settings > Automation Execution > Job** > *Paths to expose to isolated jobs*: `["/var/lib/awx/.ssh:/etc/ssh:O"]`
